---
description: "Use when creating Brand Concierge pages from Jira tickets."
applyTo: "help/**/*.md"
---

When creating a page from Jira, use one or two nearby markdown pages as
formatting templates unless the user specifies a different template. Match
their heading structure, video embed format, and tone. For go-live pages,
use `help/go-live/voice-and-visuals.md` as the initial reference.

Derive factual content from the ticket description or a usable video
transcript, not from the formatting template.
